from pathlib import Path
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # The 5 frame encloses a field; draw alternating concentric rings,
    # leaving a 3x3 empty center.
    top=next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v==5 for v in row))
    bottom=max(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(v==5 for v in row))
    left=min(c for row in grid for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5)
    right=max(c for row in grid for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5)
    t,b,l,r=top+1,bottom-1,left+1,right-1
    layer=0
    while b-t+1>3 and r-l+1>3:
        color=2 if layer%2==0 else 5
        for c in range(l,r+1):
            out[t][c]=color; out[b][c]=color
        for rr in range(t,b+1):
            out[rr][l]=color; out[rr][r]=color
        t+=1; b-=1; l+=1; r-=1; layer+=1
    return out
'''
